raw_translation: Yi ninka yankin yanki-tsaye na firam da gudun ruwa. Ga firam mai zare, yankin shi ne π sau biyu na diamita na ciki rarraba da huɗu; ka yi amfani da diamita na ciki, ba diamita na waje ba.
source: Multiply the pipe cross-sectional area by average fluid velocity. For a circular pipe, area is π times the internal diameter squared divided by four; use the inside diameter, not the outside diameter.
translation: Yi ninka yankin yanki-tsaye na firam da gudun ruwa. Ga firam mai zare, yankin shi ne π sau biyu na diamita na ciki rarraba da huɗu; ka yi amfani da diamita na ciki, ba diamita na waje ba.
